data.name: Scrapping Simulator
data.detailed_description:
⚙️ Scrapping Simulator

A low-poly first-person simulator set in a stylised Australian take on the global e-waste crisis.

Step into the steel-capped boots of an Aussie E-Waste Scrapper.

Hunt down discarded electronics, dismantle them piece-by-piece, and extract valuable materials like Copper, Silver, and Gold, along with lower-value materials such as Iron, Aluminium, Brass, and Plastic.

Sell your scrap for cash, manage your expenses and fluctuating market prices, and expand your operation through smart investments and upgrades.

Every playthrough is shaped by your choices and deep dynamic systems: daily e-waste variety, weather-affected solar power, hundreds of component combinations inside E-Waste, and ever-changing market prices.

A New Game includes a short guided tutorial (10-15 minutes) on Day 1 where time is frozen and energy is capped. Use this time to explore and learn the systems at your own pace. In-game manuals are also available for deeper dives into mechanics.

Best suited for players who enjoy hands-on tasks, meaningful progression, and managing real-world inspired challenges.

Important Clarification:

This is a realism-inspired simulator, not a sandbox destruction game. While dismantling electronics is a core detailed part of the experience, the game also includes bills, financial management, consequences to actions, and many interconnected systems. These elements seem to catch some players off-guard. If you're looking for a carefree sandbox game with no responsibilities, consequences or progression, this may not be the game for you. An Endless Sandbox Mode is not currently planned.

🛠️ Features

🔍 Scavenge & Salvage

Head out early each morning to secure the best finds before rival scrappers beat you to them. Not all junk is worth your time, learning what to take (and what to leave behind) is part of the strategy. Pull Items apart down to the last Screw and gather the Raw Materials hidden inside.

📈 Watch the Market

Track fluctuating prices on your in-game PC. Sell raw or refined metals at the Scrap Yard, offload low-tier electronics at the Pawn Shop to free up time and storage for higher-value targets. Timing and focus can directly impact your profits.

🛒 Upgrade Your Tools

Visit the Hardware Store to purchase better tools to speed up disassembly, solar panels to reduce utility costs & provide idle income, improved item transport options, expanded external storage, and other efficiency-focused upgrades. Spend wisely, not every upgrade provides immediate returns, managing your responsibilities alongside Upgrade purchases is essential.

🔥 Smelt & Refine

In the mid-to-late game, reinvest your profits into a Furnace Set, Crucible, and Ingot Moulds to turn low-value raw Base Metals into high-value ingots. Further into the late game, unlock the Chemical Set to refine pure Gold and Silver for premium returns.

The Furnace & Chemical Sets as glamorous as they sound, do not start producing Ingots out of thin air. These systems take Valuable Raw Metals you've hopefully been accumulating for this very moment, to smelt & refine them into more valuable Ingots.

💪 Level Up & Unlock Perks

Earn XP in Disassembling, Trading, and Scavenging to level-up and gain perk points across three distinct skill trees. Specialise your playstyle and refine your strategy to maximise productivity and long-term profit.

Disassembly too slow? Lean into the Disassembly Skill Tree to improve both Materials Gained and Base Disassembly Speed.

Not enough Items around to keep moving forward? Lean into the Scavenging Skill Tree which will produce more Items for you to Scrap and allow you to carry more Raw Materials.

Can't earn enough Money to sustain your lavish playstyle? Lean into the Trading Skill Tree which Improves Buying & Selling Prices to various Stores.

🧩 E-Waste You’ll Deconstruct:

  • LCDs & CRT TVs

  • Desktop Computers & Laptops

  • Microwaves & DVD Players

  • Game Consoles

  • Servers, Routers & HDDs

  • GPUs, RAM (2–32GB DDR3/DDR4) & Power Supplies

  • …and many more to come!

🔩 Internal Parts Include:

  • CPUs, IC Chips, BGA Chips

  • Capacitors, Transformers, Crystal Oscillators

  • Power Boards, Motherboards, CD Drives

  • Screws, Heat Sinks, Network Cards

  • Each component yields unique materials inspired by its real-world counterpart.

Side Missions & Player Energy

Take on optional jobs from Scrapper Joe for some extra side cash.

Need to push through a long day or got too many Items but not enough time? Grab a coffee from Kaz at “Feen 4 Caffeine” to restore energy and keep working through the night.

🧠 Developer’s Note:

Scrapping Simulator is a stylised exaggeration of today’s throwaway culture. It’s about uncovering value in the forgotten. Where some see trash on the curb, others see opportunity, raw materials waiting to be reclaimed.

This is a simulator built on freedom, consequence, and discovery. There is no single “correct” path, only the one you carve out for yourself.

data.short_description: Disassemble electronics, refine gold with chemicals, forge valuable ingots, and sell to the market in this immersive low-poly eWaste simulator.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 @ 3.1 GHz | AMD FX-6300 @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 670 | AMD R9 270
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770 @ 3.4 GHz | AMD Ryzen 5 1600 @ 3.2 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD R9 290X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
